{{Quote|I do have one other thing for you&mdash;a comlink implant. So long as you're wearing it, I can monitor your situation and speak to you privately.|[[Shara Jenn|Watcher Two]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''comlink implant''' was an implant device used by [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] that allowed for long-distance private communication, via an embedded [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] device. The wearer could communicate subvocally&mdash;only the listener would hear the wearer's whispers&mdash;and the listener could monitor the wearer's situation and speak privately with them.
